description_en: Create a backup set for an RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于为RDS实例创建一个备份集
name: CreateBackup

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to obtain the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The names of the databases that you want to back up. Separate multiple database names with commas (,).

This parameter applies only when the BackupStrategy parameter is set to db
parameters.help_zh:
数据库列表，多个数据库之间用英文逗号（,）隔开。
满足以下条件时，该参数生效：已传入BackupStrategy参数（取值为db）
parameters.name: db_name

parameters.help_en:
The backup strategy. Valid values:

db: database backup

instance: instance backup

This parameter applies only in the following cases:

For a MySQL instance, this parameter applies when the BackupMethod parameter is set to Logical.

For a SQL Server instance, this parameter applies when the BackupType parameter is set to FullBackup
parameters.help_zh:
备份策略，取值：
db：单库备份
instance：实例备份

满足以下条件时，该参数生效：
MySQL：已传入BackupMethod参数（取值Logical）。
SQL Server：已传入BackupType参数（取值为FullBackup）
parameters.name: backup_strategy

parameters.help_en:
The backup method. Valid values:

Logical: logical backup. This method is applicable only to MySQL instances that use local disks.

Physical: physical backup. This method is applicable to MySQL instances that use local disks, and to SQL Server and PostgreSQL instances.

Snapshot: snapshot backup. This method is applicable to MySQL instances that use cloud disks, and to SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and MariaDB instances.

Default value: Physical.

For logical backups, the database cannot be empty.

MariaDB instances support only snapshot backups. However, you must set this parameter to Physical
parameters.help_zh:
备份类型，取值：
Logical：逻辑备份（仅MySQL本地盘支持）
Physical：物理备份（MySQL本地盘、SQL Server、PostgreSQL支持）
Snapshot：快照备份（MySQL云盘、SQL Server、PostgreSQL、MariaDB均支持）

默认值：Physical。

使用逻辑备份时，数据库内需要有存储数据（数据不为空）。
MariaDB实例仅支持快照备份，但参数取值请填写Physical
parameters.name: backup_method

parameters.help_en:
The backup type for a SQL Server instance. Valid values:

Auto (default): The system automatically selects between a full backup and an incremental backup.

FullBackup: full backup

This parameter takes effect only when BackupMethod is set to Physical
parameters.help_zh:
SQL Server实例备份方式，取值：
Auto（默认值）：自动选择全量备份或增量备份
FullBackup：全量备份

该值仅在BackupMethod参数为Physical时生效
parameters.name: backup_type

parameters.help_en:
For SQL Server instances, you can specify the retention period for a backup set if BackupStrategy is set to db, BackupMethod is set to Physical, and BackupType is set to FullBackup. The value must be an integer from 7 to 730. A value of -1 specifies long-term retention.

MySQL: The retention period for backup sets can be 7 to 730 days, or -1 for long-term retention
parameters.help_zh:
SQL Serevr：当参数BackupStrategy为db、BackupMethod为Physical且BackupType为FullBackup时，支持指定备份集的保留时间，取值7~730天、-1（长期保留）。
MySQL：支持指定备份集的保留时间，取值 7~730 天、-1（长期保留）
parameters.name: backup_retention_period
